intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S2 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md: move every Antigravity phase-entry, admission and native-confirmation cache read/write to the shared private-file protections while preserving cache names, correlation keys and one-use grant behavior.

acceptance.assertion: Per D3 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-2): shared private helpers accept an owned 0700 directory and regular owned 0600 files and reject a planted symlink, foreign-owned file, non-regular file or wrong-mode file without an ordinary-read fallback. Positive: valid append/write/read round-trips. Negative: each enumerated attack fails closed. Bound: existing cache names and public helper semantics remain. Agreed seam: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts.

Per D3 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-2): real Antigravity PreInvocation/PreToolUse/MCP seams preserve a live drive entry, one admitted call and one consumed native grant; replay, a truncated grant and each tampered state file refuse. Positive: a valid confirmation resolves once. Negative: replayed or unsafe state cannot authorize. Bound: admission remains conversationId:stepIdx:operation and a missing step identity still denies. Agreed seam: tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts.

Per D13 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: repository evidence docs/agents/derived-files.json): regenerate the Claude bundle and complete Antigravity inventory from the shared sources and typecheck them. Positive: both generation checks pass. Negative: a stale generated copy fails. Bound: no hand-edited generated output. Agreed seam: package generation plus TypeScript.

attestations.summary: Antigravity entry/admission/confirmation state now goes through the shared private-file helpers. writePrivate and dropPrivate check owner, file type, mode and O_NOFOLLOW, and a write that fails is denied instead of falling back to ordinary IO (AC1/AC2). Both bundles carry the same changes as the shared sources, and the plugin mirrors have identical blob oids (AC3). Blast radius is medium: host-core/private_file.ts and the Antigravity/Claude lane_guard authority paths; no persisted shape or cache names change.

advisory_findings.summary: The FIFO case in the writePrivate non-regular-file test wraps its expect() in try/catch {}, so a failed assertion is swallowed and that case can never fail the test. The directory case in the same test still asserts.

evidence.trigger: writePrivate wrongly returns true for a planted FIFO → the thrown expect error is caught by the empty catch → the test still passes and the FIFO rejection is not pinned
